policy.claim_boundary: Readiness evidence is not discovery performance, validation, an edge claim, or trading authorization.
policy.decision_rule: A hypothesis is executable only with a canonical specification, authorized dataset binding, implementation binding, passing conformance evidence, and registered executor; otherwise it is blocked.
policy.minimal_blocker_rule: Report the earliest independently reviewable capability whose absence prevents an unambiguous complete chain, while retaining secondary blockers for roadmap planning.
policy.mutation_rule: Do not modify a Library hypothesis or infer executable semantics from prose; any hypothesis change requires a new child identity.
policy.scope: Assess every Library V001 hypothesis not already executable against repository-proven data, indicator, execution, and lifecycle capabilities.
